as_told.title: Göbekli Tepe pushing back the age of civilization

plain: This story is about Göbekli Tepe, a very old stone site in Turkey. The talk show host Joe Rogan says many people think it may be where civilization began, rather than Egypt. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, goes further. Leaning on the writer Graham Hancock, author of the book Fingerprints of the Gods, and on National Geographic, he dates it to about 11,000 years ago. Michels says it rewrites the map of how old human civilization is, where Rogan only calls it a possible origin. If true, it would mean advanced human culture is far older than usually told.
